integrity: A complete mathematical proof and finite reproducibility programs are provided; finite tests alone do not establish the infinite assertion. Bibliographic priority remains subject to independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Classifies rational homology representations and rational homology of full dihedral orbit spaces, not integral quotient torsion, integral lattice structures or equivariant homotopy types. Known reflection-equivariant partial results are acknowledged.
title: Dihedral homology characters and a twelve-class quotient criterion for cycle independence complexes
